    from collections import Counter

    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)

    # A horizontal line with at least two markers indicates a full row of connectors.
    for r in range(rmin, rmax + 1):
        if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for c in range(cmin, cmax + 1)) >= 2:

    for r in range(rmin, rmax + 1):
        if out[r][cmin] == background: out[r][cmin] = 2
        if out[r][cmax] == background: out[r][cmax] = 2
    return out
